verdict.rationale: A community user notes teams shared collections by exporting and importing JSON files (postman-comm-20), and the docs refer to a named Postman Collection format (postman-docs-16, postman-docs-38). That supports a native export/import capability, but there is no first-party documentation of the import/export workflow itself, and nothing shows interoperability with other tools' formats. Missing for 10: first-party import/export documentation, evidence of importing other formats (e.g. OpenAPI, cURL, Insomnia), evidence of exporting to formats other tools consume, current hands-on corroboration.
